text:
mayra.sec: quick flag — found evidence that Vault's transit wrapping key is a CMEK HSM key living in the infra project but bound (console grant) to a cross-project vendor SA. Data Access logs were OFF for this keyRing. this smells like manual onboarding that bypassed terraform.

mayra.sec: snippet from admin audit: `principalEmail=vendor-admin@vendor.example.com methodName=SetIamPolicy resource=projects/redwood-infra/locations/global/keyRings/hsm-transit`

oshin.ops: yikes. do we know if any decrypt/encrypt calls happened? without Data Access we can't tell. we should enable Data Access + sink immediately and create an ephemeral wrap key.

drew.eng: agreed. high level: 1) create ephemeral HSM-backed wrapping key in security project (wrap-hsm-ephemeral-4076543210) 2) enable Data Access logs & sink to security bq 3) lock down IAM on the ephemeral key (svc-rewrap + vault svc only) with IAM Condition limiting requester to infra VPC 4) switch Vault wrapping to ephemeral key in canary pool 5) run canary rewrap + checksum verify 6) full rewrap + rotate any related SA keys / oauth tokens 7) retire old HSM key (disable + schedule destroy) after 7 days.

vault-bot: NOTE: transit/backups and transit/partners are using current wrap key. 11 mounts report active wraps. Changing wrap key will affect running wrap/unseal ops. deploy to canary vault pool first.

kms-audit-bot: suggested sink command: `gcloud logging sinks create sink-kms-hsm bigquery.googleapis.com/projects/redwood-security/datasets/kms_hsm_audit --log-filter='resource.type="crypto_key" AND protoPayload.methodName:("Encrypt" "Decrypt") AND resource.labels.key_ring_name:hsm-transit'`

oshin.ops: I'll enable Data Access and create the sink now. post the sink output in-thread for audit.

drew.eng: creating ephemeral HSM key in security project now. will use Customer-supplied HSM protection level if possible, otherwise use Google HSM. ephemeral key IAM will be minimal. posting resource name when done.

mayra.sec: add an immediate log-based metric to page sec on any SetIamPolicy on keyRings so we don't miss future console grants.

oncall: maintenance window available 03:00-05:00 UTC tonight. prefer doing canary earlier off-hours. I can operate the rewrap.

drew.eng: rewrap canary sketch (preserve metadata; test single object):
```
OBJ=gs://vendor-archive/daily/2026-03-24/blk-0001.tar.enc
# decrypt -> encrypt streaming, preserve md5/crc32c
gsutil cp "$OBJ" - | gcloud kms decrypt --location=global --keyring=hsm-transit --key=wrap-hsm --ciphertext-file=- --plaintext-file=- | gcloud kms encrypt --location=global --keyring=hsm-transit --key=wrap-hsm-ephemeral-4076543210 --plaintext-file=- --ciphertext-file=- | gsutil cp - "$OBJ".rewrap && gsutil mv "$OBJ".rewrap "$OBJ"
```
(note: we'll run against ephemeral key in security project; adjust resource path accordingly)

mayra.sec: also snapshot object checksums and store them in the incident doc. run `gcloud logging read` after Data Access is flowing to enumerate principals that used the key in the last 30d: `gcloud logging read 'resource.type="kms_key_ring" protoPayload.methodName:("Encrypt" "Decrypt") AND resource.labels.key_ring_name:hsm-transit' --freshness=30d --format='value(protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail)' | sort | uniq -c`

oshin.ops: will run that query once logs are available and paste results. if any external vendor principals show Encrypt/Decrypt activity, we'll escalate to Legal & CISO immediately.

drew.eng: Vault change (canary): `vault write sys/wrapping/config wrap_key="projects/redwood-security/locations/global/keyRings/hsm-transit/cryptoKeys/wrap-hsm-ephemeral-4076543210"` — will deploy to vault-private canary pool. rollback = repoint to old key if wrap errors >3% in 5m.

mayra.sec: rotate any long-lived SA keys and revoke oauth tokens for principals shown in audit. if we see OIDC tokens issued to vendor-client, invalidate trust and rotate client secrets.

oncall: I'll be operator during the window. ping me 20m before canary.

drew.eng: opening terraform PR to add ephemeral key, strict IAM with condition (request.auth.principal in redwood-infra domain && request.time < now + 14d) and a deny rule preventing console SetIamPolicy on keyRings without RFC approval.

oshin.ops: sink created and Data Access enabled — posted sink output to incident doc. starting log flow; will run the principal enumeration in ~10m.

kms-audit-bot: created log-based alert: `SetIamPolicy` on keyRing targets -> page sec-oncall.

drew.eng: ephemeral key created: projects/redwood-security/locations/global/keyRings/hsm-transit/cryptoKeys/wrap-hsm-ephemeral-4076543210. posting PR link.

mayra.sec: assigning: drew = ephemeral key + canary rewrap, oshin = logs + principal enumeration + sink, oncall = operator during window, mayra = forensic timeline + legal escalation if needed. target: canary + initial audit before EOD. :thumbsup:

oshin.ops: principal list (prelim): `vault-service@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com`, `svc-rewrap@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com`, `vendor-admin@vendor.example.com` (external) — running deeper query now to get counts.

mayra.sec: if vendor-admin shows Encrypt/Decrypt counts >0, escalate. also prepare a timeline of all SetIamPolicy events on the keyRing.

drew.eng: starting canary in 15m and will post checksum diffs + vault wrap logs. will abort if any unexpected behavior.

oncall: acknowledged — pinging 20m prior to run.

kms-audit-bot: Incident INC-20260324-230 created. tasks assigned. Next update in 30m.

mayra.sec: thanks team — please paste all exact commands & outputs in this thread so we have an in-thread audit trail.
